sections.intro: ERPNext support is an ongoing service that keeps your system running after go-live. It covers hosting, backups, version upgrades, bug fixes, user questions, small changes and refresher training. Critical issues get a response within 2 hours on our priority plan, and normal requests within one working day. Our ERPNext maintenance services cover seven areas:
rows: Uptime, security patches and server health
Daily backups, stored off-server, tested monthly
Minor patches and major version upgrades
Errors in reports, scripts, print formats or workflows
New fields, report tweaks and print changes
Speed, errors, storage and security check
sections.note: As a provider of ERPNext support services Kochi firms can visit in person, we also run on-site sessions when a problem is easier to solve at your desk than over a call.

paragraphs.text: ERPNext cloud hosting keeps your system online without a server room. We offer ERPNext Frappe Cloud hosting for most clients, and AWS or DigitalOcean when you need a specific region or setup. Our ERPNext hosting services include SSL, firewalls, monitoring and daily off-server backups.

If you prefer your own hardware, our ERPNext server management covers on-premise servers too: operating system updates, database tuning, disk space alerts and backup checks. Every backup is restored to a test copy once a month, so we know it works before you ever need it.

sections.intro: ERPNext releases a major version every year and smaller patches every few weeks. Our ERPNext upgrade services move you forward safely:

items.html: 1. Check custom apps against the new version on a copy of your system.
2. Fix conflicts in scripts, reports or print formats before anything goes live.
3. Test with your team on real documents for two to three days.
4. Upgrade out of hours, with a full backup taken just before.

outro.text: A typical major upgrade takes one to two weeks of preparation and less than two hours of downtime, scheduled at night or on a weekend.

paragraphs.text: Slow screens, failed reports and error messages cost your team time every day. ERPNext bug fixing covers errors in standard features, custom scripts, print formats and integrations. Each fix is tested on a copy before release.

ERPNext performance optimization tackles slow lists and reports with database indexes, background jobs, cleaner scripts and right-sized servers. Most clients see heavy reports run several times faster after tuning.
We also set up monitoring that alerts our team when the site is down, a backup fails, a scheduled job stops or disk space runs low. Many problems are fixed before your staff notice them.

Year-end is when small setup errors become expensive. Before closing, we check open documents, stock valuation, depreciation, tax accounts and period-closing entries, then lock the year once your accountant signs off. During audits, we pull the reports your auditor asks for and explain how each figure was built. This is a standard part of the ERPNext support services Kochi clients get from us each March, and in December for GCC clients on a calendar year.

Every quarter, we review who can log in, remove former staff, check role permissions and confirm two-factor login is on for admin users. We also apply security patches as soon as they are released. Good ERPNext support services, Kochi or elsewhere, should treat security as routine work, not an emergency task.

sections.intro: Staff change, and people forget features they rarely use. Our ERPNext training keeps everyone confident:

items.text: ERPNext staff training for new joiners, by role
Refresher sessions before year-end closing and audits
Short how-to notes for repeat questions
Sessions on new features after each major upgrade

outro.text: Training is delivered online or at your office. Plan hours can be used for training as well as fixes.

sections.intro: ERPNext support plans are monthly, with a set number of hours and guaranteed response times.
sections.note: Response time means a named engineer starts working on your issue. Resolution time depends on the problem, and we update you at every step. Our ERPNext technical support works in IST for Indian clients and in GST and AST hours for GCC clients.

sections.intro: Many clients come to us when their original partner stopped responding. An ERPNext support takeover follows four steps:
rows: Secure server access and a full backup
Document custom apps, scripts and integrations
Fix urgent errors and failed backups

sections.h2: Choosing ERPNext Support Services Kochi Teams Can Rely On

items.text: Written response times in every plan.
Tested backups, restored monthly to prove they work.

items.html: No lock-in. Your data, server access and documentation stay with you.

outro.text: As an ERPNext support company and ERPNext support partner, we cover the whole system, from the server to the custom apps. That makes our ERPNext managed services simpler than splitting hosting, fixes and training across vendors. Our ERPNext application support also covers integrations and reports built by others, once we have reviewed them.

paragraphs.text: Clients use our ERPNext support in Kochi with visits from our Vyttila office. We provide ERPNext maintenance Kerala-wide, with ERPNext support Kerala clients in Ernakulam, Thrissur and Kozhikode able to book ERPNext on-site support when needed.
We provide ERPNext support India-wide through ERPNext remote support, with screen sharing and a ticket system.

paragraphs.html: For Gulf clients, ERPNext support services, Kochi-based, run in GST and AST working hours, with on-site visits when the scope needs them. See ERPNext implementation in the GCC.

items.q: Can you support an ERPNext system someone else built?
items.a: Yes. We start with a written review of the server, custom apps, scripts and integrations. After fixing urgent issues, we move you onto a monthly support plan.
It depends on your plan. Critical issues get a response within 2 hours on the Priority plan, 4 working hours on Standard and 8 working hours on Essential. Every ticket has a named engineer.

items.q: Do you upgrade to new ERPNext versions?
items.a: Yes. We test every major upgrade on a copy of your system, fix any conflicts with your custom apps, and upgrade out of hours with a full backup taken first.
You choose. Most clients use Frappe Cloud, and some prefer AWS, DigitalOcean or their own server. You keep full access to your data and backups wherever it is hosted.

items.q: What is ERPNext maintenance, and do we need it?
items.a: ERPNext maintenance covers backups, updates, security patches and monitoring. Without it, small problems such as a full disk or a failed backup can turn into lost data or downtime. Any business running ERPNext daily needs it.

items.q: What does an ERPNext support plan cost?
items.a: The price depends on your plan, the number of users and whether hosting is included. Essential plans suit small teams on a tight budget, and Priority plans suit businesses that cannot afford downtime. We send a fixed monthly quote after a short review of your system.

items.q: Do you offer weekend or after-hours support?
items.a: Yes, on the Priority plan. Critical issues such as a system outage are covered outside working hours. Upgrades and server work are scheduled at night or on weekends on every plan, so your team is not interrupted. Teams choosing ERPNext support services Kochi and GCC offices both use should check this before signing.

items.q: Do unused plan hours carry forward?
items.a: Hours can be used for fixes, small changes or training.
